summary: Skyworks Solutions filed a 424B5 preliminary prospectus supplement for a senior notes offering to finance its pending acquisition of Qorvo, Inc. The filing discloses a definitive merger agreement dated October 27, 2025, under which Skyworks will acquire Qorvo via two-step merger (First Merger into Qorvo, then into Merger Sub II). The notes offering includes three tranches, with special mandatory redemption triggers tied to the merger's completion by November 3, 2027. The 20-notes are not subject to such redemption. The merger is a strategic acquisition to combine semiconductor companies; watch for regulatory approvals, closing conditions, and consummation timeline.
